assumptions: Candidate, incumbent, oracle, tokenizer, extraction, boundary, workload and environment are fixed.
Task pairs are fresh after freezing and independent across tasks, conditional on prior search history.
All model calls and failures at the declared boundary are captured without clipping or native-count mixing.
The declared positive token cap is enforced for every full task under both policies, not just observed samples.
Binary success labels come from the configured independent evaluator, never the optimized model score.
One intact registry covers the entire error-budget family; predeclared fixed looks or the anytime rule are respected.
limits: Software cannot prove external labels true; correctness authority belongs to the configured evaluator.
No universal truth, per-task correctness, global optimum, hidden-compute, or future-drift guarantee.
Not certified means inconclusive, not proof that improvement is absent.

This margin certificate allows verified success up to quality_margin below the frozen true-off incumbent, bounded by an exact count of tasks the incumbent passes and the candidate fails; it is not a zero-regression or equal-quality claim.
Tokens per success need not improve under a tolerated quality loss; the radius field applies to neither condition.
Freshness outside registered task IDs, capture completeness and immutable identity fidelity remain caller responsibilities.

The token decision is an exact fixed-bet test at alpha_round/2; normalized_token_difference_upper is -required on a pass and 1.0 otherwise, not an interval; the claim covers each task's reference total counted at most token_cap, which equals the uncapped total where the cap assumption holds.
